title: Seasonal menu
idea: Seasonal menu: A real rotating selection uses item names, availability and complete prices as the visual hierarchy.
audience: People who need to choose offering within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Current offerings change by season or batch.
avoidWhen: Invented stock or scarcity would mislead visitors.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic collection layout through its choose offering priority and explicit commitment contract: Availability comes from actual data; never simulate remaining stock.
navigation: Seasonal menu keeps the current choose offering context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A real rotating selection uses item names, availability and complete prices as the visual hierarchy.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to choose offering; current offerings change by season or batch.
composition.priority: Availability comes from actual data; never simulate remaining stock.

imagery.role: Support the actual choose offering context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Render readable item rows and explicit sold-out alternatives.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the seasonal menu structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no choose offering content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Availability comes from actual data; never simulate remaining stock.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized choose offering content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Availability comes from actual data; never simulate remaining stock.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active choose offering context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
